author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh walnuts and homemade dough come together in these warm, comforting pastries inspired by the flavors of autumn 🍂🌰 In this video, we prepare a rustic village-style treat using fresh seasonal walnuts and simple homemade ingredients.

The pastries are baked until beautifully golden, with a soft, tender texture and a rich nutty filling inside. Fresh walnuts add a deep, natural flavor that makes every bite especially cozy during the cooler autumn days.

These walnut pastries are a simple celebration of the autumn harvest — fresh nuts, homemade dough, and traditional village baking. Warm from the oven and full of comforting flavor, they’re perfect for enjoying with tea and sharing around the family table. 🌿🍞✨

For the dough:

- 80 g butter
- 1 tea glass of milk
- 1 tea glass of water
- ½ tea glass of vegetable oil
- 1 egg
- A pinch of salt
- 1 tbsp plain yogurt
- 2 tbsp vinegar
- About 6 regular glasses of flour

For the syrup:

- 5 regular glasses of water
- 4 regular glasses of sugar
title: Fresh Walnut Pastries | Cozy Autumn Baking  🍂🌰
